dataset.language: English carrier phrases; native-speaker and speaker-count metadata not verified
dataset.licenseNote: Repository LGPL-3.0; no separate recording license identified. Audio and annotations are downloaded from upstream for validation only, not redistributed.

protocol.context: CV snippet from annotated carrier phrase
protocol.crop: Independently select target word immediately before ABOVE; select its initial stop and following vowel from words/phones tiers; start 25 ms before stop start, end at following vowel end. Manual vot tier is used only for scoring.
protocol.annotationCaveat: phones/words boundaries are alignment assistance, not manually verified release boundaries. No speaker-independent population claim.
protocol.negativeVot: Not tested: this dataset marks positive intervals only.
protocol.thresholds: 10 and 20 ms are engineering evaluation targets, not universal pronunciation standards.

conditions.quiet: Amplitude multiplied by 0.25 (-12.04 dB); same labels
conditions.noise20: Deterministic uniform noise added at 20 dB expected SNR; same labels

limits: Not consonant identification or pronunciation grading
No external model output treated as ground truth

assessment.note: Small upstream tutorial test set. Metrics do not establish cross-speaker or cross-language generalization.
